explanation: His recipe used tree bark, hemp, rags and old fishing nets. Archaeologists have found older scraps of Chinese paper, so he refined the craft rather than inventing it.

claims.text: Cai Lun, a Han dynasty court official, is credited with improving papermaking around AD 105.
Cai Lun is not credited with improving the making of silk, porcelain or gunpowder.
Cai Lun's papermaking used tree bark, hemp, rags and old fishing nets.
Archaeologists have found fragments of Chinese paper older than AD 105.
